confirmation.source: Direct user quick hotfix request and swarm-only scope correction in this chat on 2026-10-12

Overhead slow percentage text and VEIL labels are removed. Slow and cloak abilities and their existing visual effects remain active.
Balance unchanged: all 21 playable cards and the subordinate skeleton retain their 1.7.0 stats, abilities, model scales and assets. The arena remains 40 tiles long by 22 tiles wide.
Navigation rules revision 9 -> 10: new match, replay and Meta data use the hotfix rules identity.
unchanged: Every playable and subordinate definition is identical to 1.7.0. Costs, HP, damage, attack intervals, movement, ranges, projectiles, abilities, collision radii, model scales, assets and arena geometry are unchanged. Only the navigation revision identifies the corrected swarm combat rules.
